Name: Strength
Description:
Strength— or STR— represents your adventurer's athleticism, physical fitness, and the raw power they can bring to bear.
This attribute is used when employing physical force to overcome a situation, such as lifting a boulder, pushing or pulling a laden cart, or kicking down a door.

Name: Dexterity
Description:
Dexterity— or DEX— represents your adventurer's coordination, agility, reflexes, and balance.
This attribute is used when sneaking, performing precision tasks, or traversing narrow ledges.

Name: Vitality
Description:
Vitality— or VIT— represents your adventurer's health, endurance, and resistance to harm.
This attribute is used when determining your character's maximum HP and their ability to withstand damage.

Name: Intelligence
Description:
Intelligence— or INT— represents your adventurer's cognitive abilities, magical aptitude, and problem-solving skills.
This attribute is used when casting spells, solving puzzles, or engaging in scholarly pursuits.

Name: Mind
Description:
Mind— or MND— represents your adventurer's perceptiveness, instincts, and intuition.
This attribute is used when discerning someone's intent from their gestures, understanding how another person is feeling, noticing when something is out of place, or treating another character's wounds.
